v1.4.0

Release Date: March 10, 2026

🎨 UI Refresher & Polished Design

We've given Trading Logic a sleek visual upgrade! The app now fully embraces an Apple-inspired design system with cleaner typography, improved spacing, and refined semantic colors.

Typography Upgrade: We've switched to a modern, crisp font stack (Inter) for enhanced readability across all devices.
Improved Mobile Experience: The navigation bar has been optimized for mobile screens, giving you more space and a cleaner layout.
Consistent Data Visualization: Charts and tables now use standardized semantic colors (vibrant green, amber, and red) to make it easier to digest market trends at a glance.
🇪🇸 Spanish Language Support

Trading Logic is now available in Spanish! You can select Spanish from the language dropdown in the navigation bar.

While the core website remains free with ads, we will soon be introducing advanced Premium subscription options. Stay tuned for future updates as some specialized tools will become exclusive to subscribers!
